description_en: Queries information about servers on which brute-force attacks defense rules take effect
description_zh: 查询暴力破解防御规则生效的服务器信息
name: DescribeInstanceAntiBruteForceRules

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the access source
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en:
The list of server UUIDs to query.
You can call the [DescribeCloudCenterInstances](~~DescribeCloudCenterInstances~~) operation to obtain the UUIDs of servers
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的服务器UUID列表。
您可以调用[DescribeCloudCenterInstances](~~DescribeCloudCenterInstances~~)接口获取服务器的UUID
parameters.name: uuid_list

parameters.help_en: The page number of the page to return. Default value: 1, which indicates that the first page is returned
parameters.help_zh: 设置从返回结果的第几页开始显示查询结果。默认值为1，表示从第1页开始显示
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of assets to display per page in a paging query. Default value: 10000, which indicates that up to 10,000 entries of asset information are returned per page
parameters.help_zh: 设置分页查询时，每页显示的资产的数量。默认值为10000，表示每页显示10000条资产信息
parameters.name: page_size

Count.description_en: The number of servers on which brute-force attacks defense rules take effect on the current page
Count.description_zh: 当前页显示的暴力破解防御规则生效服务器的数量

CurrentPage.description_en: The page number of the current page in a paging query
CurrentPage.description_zh: 分页查询时，当前页的页码

PageSize.description_en: The maximum number of entries per page in a paging query
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时，每页最多显示的数据条数

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of servers on which brute-force attacks defense rules take effect
TotalCount.description_zh: 暴力破解防御规则生效服务器总数量

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. The ID is a unique identifier that Alibaba Cloud generates for the request and can be used to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

Rules.description_en: The list of servers on which brute-force attacks defense rules take effect
Rules.description_zh: 暴力破解防御规则生效服务器列表

Id.description_en: The ID of the brute-force attacks defense rule

Name.description_en: The name of the brute-force attacks defense rule
Name.description_zh: 暴力破解防御规则的名称

Uuid.description_en: The UUID of the server on which the brute-force attacks defense rule takes effect
Uuid.description_zh: 暴力破解防御规则生效服务器的UUID
